from decimal import Decimal
h=[15474,15754,11088,14312,16227,12910,14268,11001,12799,11441,16117,16154]
g=[10152,13977,10122,9573,12268,10947,10323,14441,7148,12581,11805,7507]
for name, xs, m in [('hgb',h,Decimal('0.001013')),('glucose',g,Decimal('0.01007'))]:
    vals=[Decimal(x)*m for x in xs]
    mean=sum(vals)/Decimal(len(vals))
    print(name,'rawsum',sum(xs),'rawmean',sum(xs)/len(xs),'mean',mean,'rounded',mean.quantize(Decimal('0.01')))
    print(vals)
PY
